newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Alaska beats Ginebra in PBA finals.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Alaska beats Ginebra in PBA finals.

text.p: Alaska Milk pummeled Ginebra San Miguel on Friday night to reach an imposing 3-0 lead in the best-of-seven finals of the Philippine Basketball Association third conference.

Alaska import Sean Chambers, who bagged the best import award before the game, led his team in defeating crowd favourite Ginebra San Miguel, 95-82. He sank in 37 points and took in 10 rebounds during the game.
Ginebra firepower Marlou Aquino, who was judged the conference's best player, was limited to only 11 points. He was fouled out with seven minutes to go in the fourth quarter.
The victory put Alaska one game away from a rare grand slam. It will be the third team to achieve such feat after Crispa Redmanizer and San Miguel Beer.
